user.title: Welcome to Home Hub

data_description.house_name: Shown as the title of this setup.
data_description.owner_name: Used on the screensaver's ON AIR sign, for example "Sam is on a work call". Leave blank to say "Someone".

people.title: Who lives here?
people.description:
Pick the people in the house. Their pictures appear at the top of the dashboards, and calendar entries that mention their name get their own colour.

lights.title: Lights
lights.description:
Pick the lights and smart sockets to show as on/off buttons. Tap a button to switch it; press and hold for more settings.

heating.title: Heating
heating.description:
Pick your thermostats and heaters. Leave empty to hide the heating section.

{found}

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.description:
Pick the cameras to show. Both are optional.

media.title: Music and TV
media.description:
Pick the main speaker, and any other speakers or TVs to control from the phone.

data.white_noise: Add a white noise button for the main speaker

doorbell.title: Doorbell

data.doorbell_sensor: Doorbell (the sensor that turns on when it rings)
data.doorbell_seconds: How long to show the camera

data_description.doorbell_sensor: Shows the driveway camera live, or the doorbell camera if there's no driveway camera.

azan.title: Azan

data.azan_sound: Azan recording (web address of an MP3)

schedules.title: Night mode and outdoor lights
schedules.description:
Night mode turns the wall tablet's screensaver into a dim clock on a black screen overnight. Outdoor lights come on at sunset and go off at sunrise.

{found}

data.night_mode: Night mode on the wall tablet

data_description.outdoor_lights: They're also put right after a restart or a power cut.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description:
Choose which dashboards to create. They appear in the sidebar as "Wall tablet" and "Phone". Running this wizard again rebuilds them, replacing any changes made to them by hand.

data.wall_dashboard: Wall tablet dashboard (landscape, with photo screensaver)
data.screensaver_photos: Show photos from My media on the screensaver
data.office_door: Office door sensor for the ON AIR sign (optional)

data_description.office_door: When this door is shut, the wall tablet's screensaver shows an ON AIR sign.

error.no_prayer_sensors: No prayer time sensors were found. Add the Islamic Prayer Times integration first, or turn this off.
error.need_tablet: Choose the wall tablet to show the camera on.
error.need_camera: Choose a driveway or doorbell camera on the Cameras page first.
error.need_speaker_or_phone: Choose a main speaker on the Music page, or at least one phone.
